newsitem.title: USA: Rioting breaks out in Florida city.
newsitem.headline: Rioting breaks out in Florida city.

text.p: Police said a large crowd of people rioted in an inner-city neighbourhood of St. Petersburg after a police officer was involved in a shooting during a traffic stop on Thursday.

"We've got a major riot," a police spokeswoman said. "It started with a shooting when a cop pulled over a motorist. It started over a few blocks, now it's over many blocks. We've got a lot of people injured ... and many cars damaged."
A police supervisor said she could not provide many details, but CNN reported that a police officer shot and killed a man during a traffic stop.
The police supervisor said the rioting had gone on for at least two hours, but "right now it's pretty much contained."
She could provide no immediate information about the number of people involved in the riot, although she said it was "a large population."
"Several units are out there trying to get the situation under control," she said.
